_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): typed fetch wrapper — baseURL, timeout, error envelope, bearer auth. Pairs with util-api-response's {ok/error} envelope. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-http-client
description: Typed fetch wrapper: JSON bodies, timeout, ApiError envelope, optional bearer auth. Place in src/lib or src/services.

variables.name: components_dir
variables.description: Frontend lib directory (src/lib for helpers, or src/services)

notes: Usage: await api('/users?page=2'); await api('/users', {method:'POST', body:{name:'Ada'}, auth:true}); Throws ApiError {status,message}. The auth flag reads the Bearer token from localStorage key 'auth_token' (set by comp-login's useAuth — it lives in the same src/components dir when comp-login is applied).
